issue.title: Rank chat payload rows by provider recency in the at-reference menu
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-e8.1 (epic sase-e8) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, deferred there by design decision D4 of plans:202608/commit_ref_completion.md: 'Chats are also recency-ordered and are a natural later adopter; file a task bead for that rather than widening this plan.'

sase-e8.1 added an optional provider-assigned `rank` to `AtReferencePayloadRowWire` (crates/sase_core/src/editor/at_reference.rs) and made it the payload comparator's tiebreak immediately after tier and score, ahead of character count and case-insensitive text. Rows that do not set `rank` keep the old ordering exactly, so adoption is opt-in and per-kind. sase-e8.2 used it for commit rows: rank is the post-merge recency index, so recency survives a typed query instead of collapsing into lexicographic order.

Chat payload rows are already enumerated in recency order (see the chat branch of build_artifact_ref_payload_inventory in crates/sase_core/src/editor/completion.rs, and payload_rows in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_artifact_ref_completion_menu.py, which sorts chats by modified_at) but declare no rank. As soon as a user types any query, tier and score can tie across many chats and the ordering falls back to shorter-text-then-alphabetical, so the newest chat is not reliably first.

Scope: assign an ascending post-sort rank to chat rows in the shared core inventory, mirror it in the prompt bar's chat row mapping so both surfaces agree, and cover it with a test that two equally-scored chat rows order by recency. Ranking for other kinds (documents, research, files, beads, agents) is out of scope; those are not recency-ordered corpora.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: deliberately deprioritized, not fixed, and not re-verified at master 0e40decdc. The project owner capped the reviewable task backlog at five, and these are narrow-scope follow-ups that did not make the cut: sase-ec (chat payload row recency ranking in the at-reference menu), sase-ef (source-free 'sase agent prompts validate' project disambiguation), sase-eq (bead path-resolution tests picking up an ambient /tmp/sdd/beads ancestor store — environment-dependent, not an xdist flake, so not consolidated onto sase-ct), sase-ex (legacy artifact created_at offset normalization, bounded to --since/date: bucketing near local midnight), and sase-f8 (stale generated memory shims and sidecar guide in the separate gh_bobs-org__bob-cli project, which additionally needs the owner's explicit memory-file permission). Scope and evidence stay readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.
